verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing documents setting up a business number in minutes and includes a new local or toll-free number per user, which covers acquiring a local number quickly. Nothing in the evidence shows searching available inventory by area code, through the UI or the API. Missing for 10: documented area-code search of available numbers, a documented purchase/provisioning flow or API endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes

citations.quote: Set up a business number in minutes
One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere
